why: Anthropic priced its IPO at $83 a share, above its $70 to $78 roadshow range, selling 980 million shares ahead of its November 19 Nasdaq debut under ANT. Following our November 12 roadshow story, this is the largest IPO in history at $81.3 billion and reshapes public AI markets, with both an official Anthropic release and wide independent coverage.

set_aside.why: Palo Alto Networks' $4.5 billion stock deal for Applied Compute is confirmed by release and SEC filing, but has narrower market impact than Anthropic's record IPO.
Citi's updated Online User Agreement shifting AI-agent liability to customers is notable for banking policy, but narrower than a $1.5 trillion public listing.
